verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent-behavior settings document a mode in which agents present a structured plan of each implementation step, which covers the plan-review part of the story. The evidence does not show that code changes are blocked until the developer approves the plan; a pause/resume API exists, but nothing ties it to plan approval. Missing for 10: an explicit approve/reject gate before code changes, documentation of how plan approval works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review and approve an agent's implementation plan before any code changes are made

citations.quote: Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
Resumes a paused agent run, allowing it to continue processing.
